# load tsv and prolific raw data
```{r}
gitrepo_path = "/Users/momocco/Documents/GitHub/srndna-ug/behavioral_analyses"

data_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"data", sep = "/")
codes_dir = paste(gitrepo_path, "codes", sep = "/")
fit_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"fits", sep = "/")
figure_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"figures", sep = "/")

trials_brains_all_df = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "singletrial_behavior_all.csv", sep = "/"), header = T)

sub_list = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "participant_L3_47.csv", sep = "/"), header = T) %>% 
  select(subjID)
N_sub = nrow(sub_list)
```

# check for autocorrelation per sub per run
```{r}
# create empty df to keep check info
auto_check_df = data.frame(matrix(nrow = N_sub*2, ncol = 1+1+4))
auto_check_col_names = c("subjID", "run", "anteriorinsula", "dacc", "VS", "vmpfc")
colnames(auto_check_df) = auto_check_col_names

brain_names = c("anteriorinsula", "dacc", "VS", "vmpfc")

auto_df_cols = c("subjID", "run", "missed", "brain", "time_order")

for (sub_s in 1:N_sub) {
  # sub_s = 1 ### for 
  subID_s = sub_list[sub_s, "subjID"]
  print(subID_s)
  N_run = 2
  if (subID_s == "sub-104") {
    N_run = 1
  }
  
  # loop through runs
  for (run_r in 1:N_run) { 
    # run_r = 1 ### for testing
    auto_check_df[(sub_s-1)*2+run_r, "subjID"] = subID_s
    auto_check_df[(sub_s-1)*2+run_r, "run"] = run_r
    
    # loop through brain regions
    for (brain_b in 1:length(brain_names)) {
      # brain_b = 1 ### for testing
      brain_name_b = brain_names[brain_b] 
      sub_r_df = 
        trials_brains_all_df[trials_brains_all_df$subjID == subID_s & trials_brains_all_df$run == run_r, c("subjID", "run", "missed", brain_name_b)]
      
      sub_r_df$time_order = 1:nrow(sub_r_df) # add time stamp
      sub_r_df = sub_r_df[sub_r_df$missed == 0,] # removed missed trials
      colnames(sub_r_df) = auto_df_cols # change column names for later use in lm()
      
      # test for autocorrelation
      auto_m = lm(brain ~ time_order, sub_r_df)
      auto_dw_test <- dwtest(auto_m)
      # extract results and save info
      dw_p = auto_dw_test$p.value
      if (dw_p > 0.05) { # no autocorrelation
        auto_check_df[(sub_s-1)*2+run_r, brain_name_b] = 0
      } else {
        auto_check_df[(sub_s-1)*2+run_r, brain_name_b] = 1
      }
    }
  }
}

write.csv(auto_check_df, paste(data_dir, "autocorrelation_check.csv", sep = "/"), row.names = FALSE)
```
